sources.name: Climate TRACE
sources.notes: 2,765,671 emission sources. Cut by emissions coverage (95% per sector) rather than an arbitrary top-N, with a 60,000-feature cap for tile size; the harvester reports both every run. Rows without coordinates are dropped rather than placed — some subsectors are gridded or country-level.
sources.discovery: resolve() in pipeline/sources/climate_trace.py — scrapes climatetrace.org/data for the newest global package. PATTERN IS INFERRED, NOT OBSERVED; run probe.py before trusting it.
sources.api_note: v7 API is public and keyless but pages at max 100 rows via limit/offset, and Climate TRACE ask that beta volume be kept low. A full harvest would be 27,000+ requests, so ingest uses bulk packages and the API is reserved for spot lookups.
sources.blocked_from_test: climatetrace.org unreachable from the build environment

sources.name: Land Matrix
sources.licence: DISPUTED: mirror README says CC BY-SA 4.0, its datapackage.json says CC BY-NC 4.0
sources.notes: 2,370 deals, 59.8M hectares across 97 countries. NO COORDINATES in the mirror despite its README describing location data, so this renders as a country choropleth, not points. Scope is deals >=200 ha in low/middle-income countries since 2000 — absence means not captured, not nothing happening.
sources.discovery: resolve() in pipeline/sources/land_matrix.py — GitHub mirror, default branch resolved each run

sources.name: Global Energy Monitor trackers
sources.notes: Download sits behind a request form, so there is no stable URL to poll. A person must fetch each release and drop it in data/manual/. Everything downstream is automated.

sources.name: Trase
sources.licence: free to download; exact terms unchecked

sources.name: Carbon Bombs
sources.licence: repo declares NO licence; underlying GEM trackers are CC BY 4.0, project data from Kuhne et al. (Energy Policy)
sources.notes: 425 projects, 1,182 Gt CO2 combined. Raw CSV serves an ETag, so release detection works. Coordinate precision varies: 330 asset-level from GEM, 92 country centroids, 3 manual — carried as x_precision and styled separately. company_data.csv is NOT harvested: its HQ coordinates were geocoded from ChatGPT-generated addresses.
sources.caution: No declared repo licence. Tracked in _publish_blockers; build proceeds, decision deferred to pre-publish.
sources.discovery: resolve() in pipeline/sources/carbon_bombs.py — GitHub API, default branch resolved each run
sources.tiles_verified: Built with tippecanoe 2.68.0: 1.0 MB, zooms 0-12, 2,070 tiles. z0 rolls up to 425 features / 1,182.3 Gt, matching the source exactly.

sources.name: Banking on Climate Chaos
sources.notes: Bank-to-company financing totals, not geocoded upstream. Needs sourced bank HQ coordinates before it can be a layer; the Carbon Bombs company file is not an acceptable source for those.
sources.discovery: resolve() in pipeline/sources/bocc.py — scrapes the download page and takes the highest year, so annual releases are picked up automatically

sources.name: Power plants (WRI Global Power Plant Database)
sources.discovery: resolve() in pipeline/sources/power_plants.py — GitHub API, master branch
sources.licence: CC BY 4.0 (database); MIT for the repo's Python source
sources.notes: All 34,936 plants, every fuel, 5,706,975 MW total. Nothing filtered — `fuel` travels per feature so filtering belongs to the reader at view time. Harvests the bleeding-edge output_database/ copy, not the tagged datasets.wri.org release.
sources.caution: capacity_mw is potential output, not emissions. Coordinates come from many upstreams of differing quality; geolocation_source is carried per feature.

_publish_blockers.issue: The dataforgoodfr/CarbonBombs repo declares no licence, which defaults to all rights reserved. The underlying GEM trackers are CC BY 4.0 and the project list is from Kuhne et al., Energy Policy.
_publish_blockers.decision: Proceeding with the build. Raise again before the map goes public.
_publish_blockers.resolve_by: attribute GEM and Kuhne et al., or ask hellodataforgood@gmail.com

_publish_blockers.issue: The datasets/land-matrix mirror states two different licences for the same data: README.md says CC BY-SA 4.0, datapackage.json says CC BY-NC 4.0. Share-alike and non-commercial are different obligations and only one can be correct.
_publish_blockers.decision: Building against the stricter reading (isolated archive, non-commercial site). Resolve against Land Matrix's own terms before publishing.
_publish_blockers.resolve_by: check landmatrix.org terms, or use their API directly rather than the mirror
